title: The Borrowed Radiators
author: Vesper Ishikawa
blurb: Wren Eastwick, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
